default.shell:
---

{{ if .Vars.win22cis_level_1 }}
  {{ if .Vars.win22cis_rule_1_1_2 }}
command:
  win22cis_1_1_2_maximumpasswordage:
    title: "1.1.2 | Ensure 'Maximum password age' is set to '365 or fewer days, but not 0' | MaximumPasswordAge"
    exec: |-
      powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$p = Join-Path '{{ .Vars.win22cis_snapshot_dir }}' 'SystemAccess.MaximumPasswordAge'; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p)) { 'NONCOMPLIANT not_collected' } else { $r = (Get-Content -LiteralPath $p -Raw).Trim(); if ($r -notmatch '^[0-9]+$') { 'NONCOMPLIANT actual=' + $r } else { $v = [int]$r; if ($v -le {{ .Vars.win22cis_maximum_password_age }} -and $v -ne 0) { 'COMPLIANT' } else { 'NONCOMPLIANT actual=' + $v } } }"
    exit-status: 0
    stdout:
      - '/^COMPLIANT$/'
    stderr:
      have-len: 0
    timeout: {{ .Vars.timeout_ms }}
    skip: {{ if eq .Vars.win22cis_system_role "standalone" }}false{{ else }}true{{ end }}
    meta:
      skip_reason: "domain scoped - on a domain joined host the Default Domain Policy sets this [System Access] value, so the role does not apply it"
      domaincontroller: 1
      memberserver: 1
      server: 1
      CIS_ID:
        - 1.1.2
      NIST800-53R5:
        - IA-5(1)
  {{ end }}
{{ end }}

discussion:
Imported from role task file `tasks/section_1/section_1.1.x.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-2022-CIS` and Audit control `section_1/section_1.1.x/cis_1.1.2.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-2022-CIS-Audit`. The CIS Benchmark text is not part of this source.

The role skips this on domain-joined hosts, where domain policy governs it.

odvs.description: win22cis_maximum_password_age is the policy setting that defines how long a user can use their password before it expires. The recommended state for this setting is 365 or fewer days, but not 0 (zero).
odvs.name: maximum_password_age

steps.name: Original Ansible tasks
steps.shell:
- name: "1.1.2 | PATCH | Ensure Maximum password age is set to 365 or fewer days but not 0"
  when:
    - win22cis_rule_1_1_2
    - not prelim_win22cis_account_policy_is_domain_scoped
  tags:
    - level1-domaincontroller
    - level1-memberserver
    - rule_1.1.2
    - patch
    - password
    - NIST800-171_3.5.2
    - NIST800-53R5_IA-5_1
  block:
    - name: "1.1.2 | PATCH | Ensure Maximum password age is set to 365 or fewer days but not 0 | Set Variable"
      when:
        - win22cis_maximum_password_age <= 365
        - win22cis_maximum_password_age > 0
        - win22cis_maximum_password_age > win22cis_minimum_password_age
      community.windows.win_security_policy:
        section: System Access
        key: MaximumPasswordAge
        value: "{{ win22cis_maximum_password_age }}"

    - name: "1.1.2 | AUDIT | Ensure Maximum password age is set to 365 or fewer days but not 0 | Warning check for maximum password age time"
      when:
        - win22cis_maximum_password_age > 365 or
          win22cis_maximum_password_age == 0 or
          win22cis_maximum_password_age <= win22cis_minimum_password_age
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg:
          - "Warning!! You have an invalid age set for win22cis_maximum_password_age please read"
          - "the notes for the variable and make the necessary change to the variable to be in compliance."
          - "Also verify your win22cis_maximum_password_age is more then the win22cis_minimum_password_age"

    - name: "1.1.2 | AUDIT | Ensure Maximum password age is set to 365 or fewer days but not 0 | Set warning count"
      when:
        - win22cis_maximum_password_age > 365 or
          win22cis_maximum_password_age == 0 or
          win22cis_maximum_password_age <= win22cis_minimum_password_age
      vars:
        warn_control_id: '1.1.2'
      ansible.builtin.import_tasks:
        file: warning_facts.yml
